name: Marrakech
summary: Combine one or two palace or garden visits with unhurried time in the medina. The square is an experience to assess on your own terms, with quieter streets and cafés nearby.
seasonNote: Summer afternoons are very hot; Ramadan and religious holidays can change opening and dining patterns.
arrival: Confirm your riad’s nearest vehicle-accessible drop-off before booking an airport transfer.
gettingAround: Walk the medina; use agreed-price licensed taxis for outer districts. Maps help but narrow lanes can be confusing.
cashTip: Carry small MAD notes for meals, taxis and markets; keep the full trip budget separate.
foodTip: Try tagine, harira and fresh bread; choose clean busy stalls and agree prices before ordering.
buyTip: Look for ceramics, textiles and spices; bargain politely, compare quality and confirm shipping costs.
baseArea: Medina edge for atmosphere and easier transfers; Gueliz for convenience

connections.note: Approximate daytime rail journey, often around 7 hours; check current ONCF timetable.
